Include Max/Min Moneyness in summaries

Compute and export yearly max/min moneyness alongside existing summary statistics. Updated Procedure__Run_Summary_Statistics.m to initialize Yearly_Max_Moneyness/Yearly_Min_Moneyness, update them from per-record Moneyness (using max/min), and append the two values to Summary_Results and output table variable names. Regenerated Summary_Stats_TTM_30/60/90/180.csv to include the new Max_Moneyness and Min_Moneyness columns.

Add script and summary stats for TTM analysis

Added Procedure__Run_Summary_Statistics.m to compute yearly summary statistics for multiple target TTM values. Generated and added summary CSV files for TTM 30, 60, 90, and 180 days, containing yearly aggregated option statistics.

Add historical realized return data CSV

Added Old_Realized_Return_TTM_30.csv containing historical realized return data by date for further analysis or reference.

Refactor risk-free rate calculation for multiple TTM

Rewrote the risk-free rate calculation to support interpolation and output for four different TTM horizons (30, 60, 90, 180 days) instead of a single fixed TTM. Updated input/output paths, removed Mac path logic, and added plotting for the resulting series. Added the generated Risk_Free_Rate.csv file containing the new output format.

Update TTM target to 30 and adjust plot limits

Changed Target_TTM from 180 to 30 in Main__Calculate_g_Function_Derivative.m and Main__Theta_Estimation.m. Updated y-axis limits for various plots in Main__Calculate_g_Function_Derivative.m and Main__Plot_cubic_B_spline.m to better fit the new data range. Updated related output files to reflect these changes.

Update RND table .mat files for all years

Refreshed all TTM RND table .mat files (30, 60, 90, 180) for years 1996-2022 in the 'no dividend' directory. These updates likely reflect new or corrected data for each period and maturity.

Add script and outputs for g function derivatives

Added Main__Calculate_g_Function_Derivative.m to compute and plot the g function and its derivatives using B-splines for various TTM values. Also added corresponding Excel and PNG output files for TTM 30, 60, 90, and 180, containing the computed results and visualizations.

Add script and plots for cubic B-spline visualization

Added Main__Plot_cubic_B_spline.m to generate and plot cubic B-spline basis and their linear combinations for various TTM and b values. Output figures for each configuration are saved as PNGs in the designated output folder.

Rename old_Realized_Return_TTM CSV files to div_Realized_Return_TTM

Renamed four CSV files from old_Realized_Return_TTM_[30|60|90|180].csv to div_Realized_Return_TTM_[30|60|90|180].csv for consistency in naming conventions.

Rename Main__Theta_Estimation_Brief.m to Main__Theta_Estimation.m

Renamed the file for consistency or clarity. No changes to the file contents.

Rename Procedure__Theta_Estimation_Brief.m to Main__Theta_Estimation_Brief.m

Renamed the file to better reflect its role as the main entry point for theta estimation procedures.

Add GMM theta estimation scripts and results

Added MATLAB scripts for GMM theta estimation using B-splines (GMM_theta_estimation.m and Procedure__Theta_Estimation_Brief.m) and output .mat files containing estimated theta parameters for various TTM and basis counts. These additions support the estimation and storage of model parameters for the CDI method as described in the 2021 JBF (spcol) workflow.

Update TTM target and calculation logic

Changed the target time-to-maturity (TTM) from 60 to 180 days and adjusted the TTM calculation offset from 2 to 4. This aligns the script with new analysis requirements for longer maturities.

Add script to compute and export realized returns

Added Realized_Return.m to compute realized returns for S&P 500 index over various TTM periods and export results to CSV. Updated the output CSV files for TTM 30, 60, 90, and 180 with new realized return calculations and date alignments.

Update TTM parameter and add old realized return data

Changed TTM from 180 to 60 and updated the input filename in Realized Return.py. Added historical realized return CSV files for TTM values of 30, 60, 90, and 180 for reference or comparison.

Update dates in TTM_180.csv

Corrected the 'date' and 'exdate' values for the entry at line 71, changing 20010912,20020315 to 20010917,20020316.

Add TTM_180_RND_Tables MAT files for 1996-2022

Added 27 new .mat files containing TTM_180_RND_Tables data for each year from 1996 to 2022 in the 'no dividend' directory. These files are likely used for time series or panel data analysis.

Add TTM_90_RND_Tables .mat files for 1996-2022

Added 27 new MATLAB .mat files for years 1996 through 2022 in the 'no dividend' directory. These files likely contain time series or tabular data for each year, supporting further analysis or processing.

Add TTM_60_RND_Tables .mat files for 1996-2022

Added a series of MATLAB .mat files containing TTM_60_RND_Tables data for each year from 1996 to 2022 in the 'no dividend' directory. These files likely provide annual data for further analysis or processing.

Correct dates in TTM_60.csv data file

Updated several date and exdate entries in TTM_60.csv to correct data inaccuracies for the years 2002, 2013, and 2019.

Add TTM_30_RND_Tables .mat files for 1996-2022

Added 27 new MATLAB .mat files for each year from 1996 to 2022 in the 'no dividend' directory. These files likely contain time series or tabular data relevant to the project.

Add MATLAB scripts for RND estimation without dividends

Added four new MATLAB files for risk-neutral density (RND) estimation in the 'no dividend' scenario: CheckError_GEV_PDFCDF.m, F2010_RND_MultipleDate.m, Fit_GEV_PDF.m, and RF_TTM.m. These scripts implement the workflow for constructing RNDs from option data, including risk-free rate interpolation, GEV tail fitting, and error checking.

Fix date entry in TTM_60.csv

Corrected the date from 19961225 to 19961224 and the exdate from 19970221 to 19970222 in the TTM_60.csv file.

Refactor RF_TTM.m for efficiency and robustness

Improved date handling by converting to datetime objects, added preallocation for output, and enhanced the search for available data up to 10 days prior to the target date. Added linear extrapolation for out-of-range TTM values and informative messages when no data is found. The code is now more robust and efficient.
